# deeplink_link (Resource)

Manages a short link on a deeplink server (`POST /shorten`, `PATCH /{id}`, `DELETE /{id}`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Processor type (e.g. `redirect`). Changing forces replacement.
- `url` (String) Destination URL (http/https).

### Optional

- `description` (String) OG description. Server may default this for redirects.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 expiry. Changing forces replacement (not patchable by the API).
- `image_alt` (String) OG image alt text.
- `image_height` (Number) OG image height hint.
- `image_url` (String) OG image URL.
- `image_width` (Number) OG image width hint.
- `locale` (String) og:locale override.
- `og_type` (String) og:type value (e.g. `website`, `article`).
- `title` (String) OG title. Server may default this for redirects.

### Read-Only

- `clicks` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Canonical ID (`type/short_id`).
- `short_id` (String) Generated short ID.
- `short_link` (String) Full short URL including the server base URL.
- `updated_at` (String)
